annotations.title: Sell a Robinhood Chain token (agent trading)

description: Sell part or all of a Robinhood Chain token the member holds in their PumpPill trade bot wallet, as a percent of the holding (1-100). Needs the member's agent key (X-Agent-Key: ppa_..., made in PumpPill's Telegram trade bot under Settings, AI agent). A sell is never refused for the token's read. Written down before it is placed; poll agent_order for the result. Moves real money: confirm with the member first.
name: agent_sell
